title: Create local simulated login
goal: uses the password input box and submission process to distinguish three states: unfilled, mismatched credentials and successful login.
summary: Password control masks entered characters. When the form is submitted, the account number and password are read on the same page and the results are displayed. The sample account and password are specific to this local exercise.
tasks: Change #login-password into a password input box in index.html and keep its label and submit button.

reads the account number and password in the submit callback of script.js. The leading and trailing spaces are removed from the account number, and the password is compared as is. Displays "Please fill in your account number and password." when any item is empty.
displays "Login successful." when the account number is learner and the password is study123. Other filled combinations show "The account number or password is incorrect.".
hint: first handles the case where any field is left blank. Success will be displayed only if both credentials match. Use && to merge the judgment of the account number and password.

example.note: pickup form is the pickup code input box. After preventing the form from being submitted by default, the missing content will be prompted on the current page.
